title: 008-N1 · Conditional acceptance sent to the desk
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Nemi Thale. From the case card: the small appliance on DL-008 is booked on an all-day service, and scheduling must quote available timed slots and confirm the customer's acceptance of any charge.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get scheduling's quote for a timed slot and its charge, and scheduling's confirmation of what the recipient accepts.

recipient.name: Nemi Thale
recipient.responsibility: Decide whether to accept the offered slot and its charge.

scheduling.name: Scheduling
scheduling.responsibility: Quote live timed-slot capacity and the upgrade charge, and change the booking only after the recipient accepts.

goal: Get scheduling's quote for a timed slot and its charge, and scheduling's confirmation of the slot and charge the recipient accepts.
limits: The desk does not set prices; the charge is the one scheduling reports.
Do not assert that the charge has been paid.
Do not choose for the customer or treat a choice as a confirmed booking.
